publications.title: Publications or posts
publications.description: Substack publications or single posts. Accepts a subdomain (lenny or lenny.substack.com), a custom domain (www.lennysnewsletter.com), any publication URL, or a post URL (https://name.substack.com/p/post-slug).

maxPostsPerPublication.title: Max posts per publication
maxPostsPerPublication.description: Stop after this many posts for each publication (newest first). Each post is billed as one event.

includeContent.title: Include post content (HTML + text)
includeContent.description: Also download each post's body as HTML and plain text. Paid posts only include the public preview (marked truncated: true). Billed at the post-with-content price instead of the metadata price.

sinceDate.title: Only posts since
sinceDate.description: Only posts published on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD, or relative like "7 days" or "1 month". Scraping stops as soon as older posts are reached, so scheduled runs only pay for new posts.

search.title: Search keyword
search.description: Optional. Only posts matching this keyword, using the publication's own archive search. Results are ordered by relevance, not date.

onlyNew.title: Only new posts (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only posts not returned by an earlier run with the same publications and search. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-post alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new posts and stop reading each archive after 3 known posts in a row. State is kept in the key-value store "substack-scraper-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed normally; use Apify Proxy only if Substack starts rate-limiting very large runs.
